    BO13a §2.2.5: no third long morphism #

    Two long entries σ (s+2) and the next long entry, both split at one point, give a cleaving diagram of type D̃ in P/τ for any third long morphism τ.

    • MulBasis.b2_third: the next long entry is ρ (s+3+L+1) (BO13a figure 9.4; not_zigzag_arms, or the tree F94S for L = 0).
    • MulBasis.b3_third: the next long entry is σ (s+3+L+1) (BO13a figure 9.5; not_zigzag_arms_src).
